description: Plan a release's scope in its version milestone, draft it, have a person baseline it, hand it off, assign Feedback, and hold drift to the change budget.

accept.description: Accept the Release's waiting request, a drafted baseline or a change over budget, through GitHub's device flow every time; aayu inbox shows the same card.

add.description: Initiative, Feature, Story, or Bug to add to the release's milestone; after a baseline it counts as drift.

assign.description: Feedback issue to assign with --to; sets its milestone and horizon label, never its body, and is not drift.

decision.description: Accepted Decision that names the Release: with --add, --drop, or --draft over budget, it asks a person to accept the change; never applies it.

draft.description: Snapshot the plan on the ledger (releases/<version>/draft.json) and ask a person to accept it; refuses an unsized, XL, or unsliced plan.

drop.description: Item to remove from the release's milestone, so it rides a later release; after a baseline it counts as drift.

handoff.description: Hand the baselined plan off: write the Release's includes links and post the plan on it.

release.description: Release issue (Version vX.Y.Z) whose scope to plan; without another flag, scope reports the plan, its points, and its drift.

to.description: With --assign: this release, the next release milestone, or the backlog.

title: scope
